question: What original evidence connects Gonur tokens and the Altyn Depe impressed object to inventories and contexts?
outcome: Recovered original 1998, 2005 and 2008 publications. Gonur reports 26 tokens; its photograph and drawing panels each show 23 representations. Altyn Depe Plate 94.2 gives one item, three views, Excavation 5, horizon 11 and room 18, with a tentative seal-imprint caption. The original elephant-seal context is recovered.
challenge: Individual token IDs, panel correspondence, numbered hoard room and hoard date are missing. A nested book link initially returned 404.
remedy: Recover official public downloads, preserve the original caption classification, count representations in separate panels, confirm counts with a second source-informed model and resolve the book link against the domain root.
retry_when: Individual token inventories, reverse views, marked-object photographs or a deposit/date join add observations beyond the illustrated panel sample.
